title: GitHub Actions 临时产物保留防线
summary: 将 Actions artifacts 视为短期诊断通道而非归档存储；普通 push/PR 不上传，手工诊断才允许短期上传，长期产物进入 Release，并用 policy-as-code 强制执行。
rules: Routine push and pull_request workflows SHOULD retain zero Actions artifacts.
upload-artifact SHOULD be restricted to explicit workflow_dispatch unless a documented exception exists.
Transient diagnostic artifacts SHOULD use deliberately short retention.
Long-lived release assets SHOULD live in a release/archive channel, not routine CI artifact storage.
The policy SHOULD be machine-enforced rather than documentation-only.
applicability: repositories where Actions artifact growth can create cost/storage pressure
